_about: The beat: which stories the engine brings Krish and which it leaves out. Ruling (Krish, 2026-11-24): the engine brings stories in his focus sectors (media, entertainment, content, arts, music, creator tech, with the economics of AI inside them) and not governance, regulation, security or data breaches. Ruling (Krish, 2026-11-25): sports is a focus sector too, beside the creative, arts, music, entertainment and media industries. Read by apps/control-plane/api/_beat.ts (the headline gate for the feed, the radar, investigations, creator posts and shift detection; avoid terms refuse a headline outright, focus terms keep a focus-sector headline that the release, launch or partnership rule would otherwise drop, and an enterprise productivity headline is kept only with a focus-sector angle), apps/control-plane/api/feed/ingest.ts (pool_categories_off_beat), apps/control-plane/api/_editorialRadar.ts (the lens prompt's beat block) and scripts/post-pack/idea_checks.py offbeat_findings (the Sunday gate, code off_beat: a board option on the avoid list with no focus-sector angle is refused). A keyword is a row here, never code. A keyword ending in * matches any ending (royalt* matches royalty and royalties); not_when phrases are taken out of the text before its keywords are read, so 'job security' is not a security story and 'state of the art' is not an art story. Changed only by a pull request carrying his ruling.

his_words.said: dont forget that in the makeyourmindup session, we need to ensure the engine brings the best of stories and ideas that I want to move towards, as opposed to governance, data breaches etc. I really liked the AI Music piece, it got good response the way it was broken down. we can still keep a focus on the economics of AI but in these focus sectors

media, entertainment, content, arts, music and creativity; creative technologies, creator technologies, anything helping individuals express themselves better and businesses move ahead using these channels; DoThinkDo-type businesses (theatre actors monetising creativity). Positive spin. Keep the economics of AI inside those sectors.
